claude.sample_unit: images assessed by 15 clinicians with and without CAD

links.outcome: Clinician Checklist I assessment accuracy with versus without CAD support
links.effect: Mean clinician accuracy increased from 72.3% to 90.2% with CAD, a paired improvement of 17.9 percentage points (95% CI, 10.3–25.4; p<0.001; Cohen's dz=1.31); all 15 clinicians improved.
